name: Conch Salad
desc: Raw conch chopped with lime, onion, tomato and pepper at the Conch Shack, in front of you. Sharp, fresh and a bit alarming. Restores 190 HP.

name: Johnny Cake
desc: A sweet, dense fried bread, eaten with fish for breakfast. It may be named for 'journey cake', or it may not. Restores 140 HP.

name: Turks Island Salt
desc: Coarse white salt raked by hand from the Grand Turk ponds, once shipped across the Atlantic. Restores 15 PP to every move, and improves chips.

name: Carpenter's Saw
desc: A battered saw with a worn handle and a very good ring. In a ripsaw band it is scraped with a screwdriver, not used on wood.

name: Goatskin Drum
desc: A hand-made drum with a goatskin head, kept dry in an old fishing boat. It has seen more parties than anyone will admit.

name: Gourd Shaker
desc: A dried gourd packed with seeds, rattled behind the beat. The museum was not supposed to lend it out.

name: Conch Shell Horn
desc: A conch shell with the tip cut off, blown to call boats home. A good one can be heard from the other side of the island, and the other side of the argument.
msg: {name}'s Conch Shell Horn blew the tide aside!
